repo.description:
### Impact

A missing sanitization allowed malicious users to circumvent the content security policy when a malicious user manages to trick a user it viewing an uploaded SVG outside of the Nextcloud Servers web page.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 31.0.12 or 32.0.3
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 31.0.12 or 32.0.3

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3357808)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/viewer/pull/3023)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: XSS in SVG images when opened outside of Nextcloud
